Territory

Two specialities,
learned properly

Agricultural and commercial property are not residential property with more ground. Water rights, soil, access, zoning, yield, the working season, what the building costs to run - these decide the price. I have spent a decade in the two markets where getting that wrong is expensive.

Agricultural

Farms, land & smallholdings

Working farms, cultivated land, lifestyle smallholdings and the infrastructure that comes with them. Priced on what actually drives value - water, soil, access, yield and the realistic buyer pool - not on what the seller hopes.

Approach

An owner’s perspective

Before real estate I ran my own businesses - a courier company, and a loss adjusting firm built with my wife. That is a different education to a sales course. I know what it costs to make a payroll, and what it feels like to sign away something you built.

So a transaction is never “just business” to me. A property sale is usually the largest financial decision a family makes, and often the most emotional one. My job is to guide it personally, from the first walk of the boundary to the day of transfer - and to tell you the truth about price even when the truth is unwelcome.

You will deal with me. Not an assistant, not a call centre, not a junior who has never seen the property. I answer my own phone, I do my own viewings, and I would rather lose a mandate than win it on a number I cannot defend.

What I offer sellers is a transparent process and an honest valuation. What I offer buyers is someone who will tell them when a farm is wrong for them.

Off the clock

The bush, the mountains,
and Gillian

Thirty-five years married, two daughters we are extremely proud of - one with an Honours degree in HR Management from Stellenbosch, one finishing her Master’s to become a Doctor of Chiropractic. My wife taught me the principle I try to run my life on: keep giving. It comes back tenfold.

When I am not looking at property or wildlife, I am on a mountain bike or hiking the Cape mountains. It keeps the head clear and it is the best way I know to learn a district properly.
